en.html:
常闇斎"—That concludes Professor Wolf’s message."
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"So that is it... Damn. Complications have arrived in full strength."
Chachamaru"Which distinguished somebody put his unnecessary finger into this?"
Kageaki"If the Forged Bomb is unavailable—"
Chachamaru"Our plan collapses. Rokuhara need not mind; the occupation forces need not use it if they can win a straight fight. But we mind."
常闇斎"It is the key. To bring the dawn..."
Kageaki"Then what do we do?"
Chachamaru"Follow Wolf’s arrangement. Resist."
Chachamaru"Create a situation in which League headquarters decides to use the bomb."
常闇斎"Withstand the occupation offensive and force a stalemate."
Chachamaru"Today is... November thirtieth."
Chachamaru"The Princess wakes on December fourth."
常闇斎"Four days. In a sense, a convenient interval..."
常闇斎"If they cannot take Fudaraku in that time, it should suffice to make them commit their decisive weapon."
Chachamaru"Yes. Getting that timing right is Wolf’s work."
Chachamaru"We hold Fudaraku for four days."
常闇斎"Yes..."
Kageaki"...Can we?"

常闇斎 「――以上が、ウォルフ教授からの連絡です」
景明 「…………」
茶々丸 「そーゆーわけかよ……。 　くそ。面倒なことになった！」
茶々丸 「どこの誰様が余計な邪魔入れやがったんだ」
景明 「鍛造雷弾が使えない、となると――」
茶々丸 「あてらの目論見はぶっ潰れるね。 　六波羅は困らないし、進駐軍だってまとも な勝負で勝てるならあえて雷弾を使わなくて もいいだろうけど、あてらは・・・・困るね」
常闇斎 「あれが鍵ですから。 　夜明けを導くための……」
景明 「ならばどうする？」
茶々丸 「ウォルフのお膳立てに従うしかないよ。 　抗戦する」
茶々丸 「連盟本部が鍛造雷弾の使用を決断する状況 を作り上げる」
常闇斎 「進駐軍の攻勢を凌ぎ切り、膠着状態に持ち 込むということですね」
茶々丸 「今日は……一一月三〇日か」
茶々丸 「御姫が目覚めるのは一二月四日だ」
常闇斎 「あと四日ですか。 　丁度良いといえば、丁度良い長さ……」
常闇斎 「それだけの時間を掛けても普陀楽を陥とせ ないとなれば、決戦力の投入を決意させるに は充分でしょう」
茶々丸 「だな。 　そこんところのタイミングをうまく合わす のはウォルフの仕事だ」
茶々丸 「あてらは四日間、普陀楽を守り切る」
常闇斎 「ええ……」
景明 「…………。 　できるか？　それが」

Chachamaru"Where is Shishiku?"
Raichou"Already flown to Aizu."
童心"How quickly Sasagawa’s reinforcements reach Fudaraku will decide victory or defeat."
Chachamaru"I see."
童心"They have caught us neatly. I assumed the occupation forces would obtain their reason to fight and win only after His Highness’s appointment restored Rokuhara."
童心"To strike beforehand..."
Raichou"Yes. GHQ have outmaneuvered us beautifully!"
童心"Militarily, striking our dispersed forces is advantageous. But they do not consider us an equal opponent. I expected political convenience to take priority."
Raichou"Perhaps something is happening behind the scenes."
Chachamaru"Wonder later. Whatever the reason, the enemy is already there."
Chachamaru"Does not look like they came for a ceremony invitation. Then politely request their departure. Let us consider how to begin their winter swimming contest in the bay."
童心"Indeed..."
Raichou"Doushin, their movements?"

雷蝶 「もう会津へ飛んだわ」
童心 「篠川からの援軍が、どれだけ早く普陀楽へ 着くか……。 　そこが勝敗の分かれ目となるゆえ」
茶々丸 「そっか」
童心 「しかし、やられ申したな。 　邦氏殿下への大将領宣下によって六波羅が 再起を果たした時こそ、進駐軍は戦う意味と 勝つ意味とを得るのだと思い決めておった」
童心 「よもや、その前に仕掛けて来ようとは……」
雷蝶 「ええ。 　綺麗に裏をかいてくれたわ、ＧＨＱやつら！」
童心 「確かに軍事的には兵力が分散している内に 叩く方が有利……しかし六波羅われらを対等の相手 などと思っておらぬ奴らのこと、必ずや政治 的都合の方を優先すると踏んでおったのだが」
雷蝶 「何か裏事情があるのかもしれませんわね」
茶々丸 「……それをいま勘繰ったって仕方ねえだろ。 　事情はともかく、敵さんはもう相模湾そこまで 来てるんだ」
茶々丸 「宣下式典に参列したくて来たようには見え ねえし、だったら丁重にお帰り願うしかねえ。 　方法を考えようぜ。やつらに相模湾で寒中 水泳大会始めてもらうためのさ」
童心 「で……ござるなァ」
雷蝶 「童心様、敵の動きは？」

en.html:
童心"A fleet believed to be the Yokosuka occupation fleet broke through the inner bay defenses and raided Kotsubo naval port, damaging our main fleet there—"
童心"When Kotsubo prepared to counterattack, they withdrew as though waiting for that moment. They now blockade between Iijimazaki and Oosaki, keeping the surviving fleet inside."
Raichou"...Only keeping it inside?"
童心"Yes."
Chachamaru"Hah? What do these fellows want?"
Chachamaru"Kotsubo’s fleet trapped, painful enough. But if the enemy only maintains a blockade, no need to move that fleet in the first place."
童心"Naturally, they must be preventing interference with operations elsewhere..."
Raichou"Surely Kamakura is their target? They intend another city?"
Chachamaru"Nonsense."
童心"Occupy Kamakura, take Fudaraku, destroy Rokuhara. Having finally moved, GHQ can have no other purpose."
童心"Yet—"
Chachamaru"Then why not crush Kotsubo quickly and land? ...Diversion?"
童心"The main force... comes overland from Yokohama, across Asahina Pass?"
Raichou"From that direction also, certainly. But it is unsuitable for rapid deployment of a large force."
Raichou"The main thrust elsewhere, I think."
童心"...Indeed. Then..."
童心"Here?"

童心 「進駐軍横須賀艦隊と思われる艦群は、相模 湾内防線を突破後、小坪こつぼ軍港を急襲。 　小坪に駐留する我が方の主力艦隊に損害を 与え――」
童心 「小坪側が反撃態勢を整えると、それを見計 らっていたように撤収。 　現在は飯島崎と大崎の間に封鎖線を張り、 小坪の残存艦隊を港に押し込めており申す」
雷蝶 「……押し込めてるだけ？」
童心 「さよう」
茶々丸 「はァ？ 　何がしたいんだあいつら」
茶々丸 「小坪の艦隊が動けなくなったらそりゃ痛い けど。 　向こうが封鎖以外なにもしないんだったら、 艦隊を動かす必要がそもそもねえぞ」
童心 「むろん、他方面での行動を妨害させぬため に封じておるのでござろうが……」
雷蝶 「まさか、あいつらの狙いは鎌倉ではないと いうの？ 　他の都市を襲うつもり？」
茶々丸 「んなアホな」
童心 「鎌倉を占領し、普陀楽を陥とし、六波羅を 壊滅に追い込む。 　ＧＨＱが遂に動いたからには、他の目的は 考えられぬ」
童心 「しかし――」
茶々丸 「ならどうしてさっさと小坪港を叩き潰して 上陸してこねえのかって話だな。 　……小坪攻撃は陽動か？」
童心 「本隊は…… 　横浜基地から陸路、朝比奈峠を越えて攻め 寄せてくる？」
雷蝶 「勿論そちらからも来るでしょうけれど……。 　そのルートは大兵力を素早く展開するには 不都合です」
雷蝶 「本命は別かと」
童心 「……で、ござるな。 　と――――なると……」
童心 「ここかの」

Raichou"...The Shounan coast?"
Chachamaru"Oi, oi. How are they landing a great army THERE? Idiots."
Chachamaru"Is what apun would love to say. Unfortunately, some convenient weapon for that situation exists, no?"
童心"Indeed. Landing ships. The Commonwealth has used them since the last great war."
Raichou"I heard they were not very effective."
童心"Perhaps they improved upon their failures. An invading nation would find such a weapon worth considerable research."
童心"Attacking a well-defended port requires heavy sacrifices. Landing on a lightly defended beach could reduce losses greatly."
Chachamaru"...Lightly defended, yes. Zaimokuza, Yuigahama, Shichirigahama."
Chachamaru"Not wide open, but perfect is not the word."
Raichou"Entirely inadequate against a major landing operation. GHQ will know that much."
童心"..."
Chachamaru"Then... they are coming."
Raichou"Yes."
Chachamaru"Reinforce the beaches?"
童心"Pointless. Taken by surprise, we have no sufficiently large force ready to move."
童心"Even if we deployed successfully, we lack the know-how to repel a major landing."
Chachamaru"Crushed while fumbling in the sand? No need for quite so much pessimism."
Raichou"They have certainly trained thoroughly. If the number of mistakes decides the result, we are at a disadvantage."
Chachamaru"...Cannot argue."
童心"We must abandon defense of the bay coast."
Kageaki"Forgive the interruption. ...Will we not consider breaking Kotsubo’s blockade?"

童心"Indeed. Landing ships. The Commonwealth has used them since the last great war."
Raichou"I heard they were not very effective."
童心"Perhaps they improved upon their failures. An invading nation would find such a weapon worth considerable research."
童心"Attacking a well-defended port requires heavy sacrifices. Landing on a lightly defended beach could reduce losses greatly."
Chachamaru"...Lightly defended, yes. Zaimokuza, Yuigahama, Shichirigahama."
Chachamaru"Not wide open, but perfect is not the word."
Raichou"Entirely inadequate against a major landing operation. GHQ will know that much."
童心"..."
Chachamaru"Then... they are coming."
Raichou"Yes."
Chachamaru"Reinforce the beaches?"
童心"Pointless. Taken by surprise, we have no sufficiently large force ready to move."
童心"Even if we deployed successfully, we lack the know-how to repel a major landing."
Chachamaru"Crushed while fumbling in the sand? No need for quite so much pessimism."
Raichou"They have certainly trained thoroughly. If the number of mistakes decides the result, we are at a disadvantage."
Chachamaru"...Cannot argue."
童心"We must abandon defense of the bay coast."
Kageaki"Forgive the interruption. ...Will we not consider breaking Kotsubo’s blockade?"

en.html:
I could not remain silent. These leaders appeared to have discarded the option from the beginning.

I could not accept that. No need to demand a desperate gamble from the surviving Kotsubo fleet. Bring another nearby fleet to attack from outside while they attacked from within.

Surely every shogunate ship around Sagami Bay had not assembled at Kotsubo. Free it, and the enemy’s landing operation would immediately become precarious.

en.html:
Listening to the Lord of Koga’s discussion, I reviewed what I knew of Fudaraku’s strength.

First, the Fudaraku Castle corps. Directly under the castle lord, currently Shirou Kuniuji Ashikaga. He was too young to command an army, so senior retainer Doushin Yusa performed the duties.

Second, the Koga contingent. Part of Koga’s army stationed at Fudaraku, commanded by Doushin or his representative.

Third, the Oyumi contingent. Its territory could send troops here relatively quickly, so its force was somewhat larger than the other detachments.

Fourth, the Horigoe contingent. Chachamaru held command. Reflecting Horigoe’s wealth, its logistics were excellent and often attracted other units’ envy—irrelevant now.

Fifth, the Sasagawa contingent. Detached from Shishiku Ootori’s Aizu-Sasagawa army, praised as Rokuhara’s finest.

These five groups formed Fudaraku’s permanent strength: Rokuhara’s central army, the largest military force in Kanto.

Even so, alone it could not match GHQ. To fight on equal terms required regional reinforcements.

ja.html:
古河公方主導の談義を耳で聴きつつ。
　俺は普陀楽の軍事力に関する知識を反芻した。

　第一は普陀楽城衆。
　普陀楽城主直轄の軍団だ。現在は足利四郎邦氏隷下
となる……が、彼はまだ一軍の指揮に耐える年齢では
ないため、宿老遊佐童心が実務を代行している。

　第二は古河領衆。
　古河公方府の軍兵から一部を割いて普陀楽城に駐留
させているものである。指揮は当然古河公方遊佐童心、
又はその代理の者が執る。

　第三は小弓領衆。
　小弓公方府よりの派遣軍である。他の公方府よりも
比較的早く普陀楽城へ兵力を送れる環境にあるため、
規模も他の派遣軍よりやや大きい。

　第四、堀越領衆。
　堀越公方府の派遣軍であり、指揮権は茶々丸が持つ。
堀越の富裕な財政を反映してか兵站の面で優れ、しば
しば他部隊にやっかまれる――今はどうでもいいが。

　第五は篠川領衆。
　大鳥獅子吼の指揮下、六波羅最精鋭と謳われる会津
篠川軍団より分かれて普陀楽に詰める将兵である。

　この五つの軍集団が普陀楽の常駐戦力を構成する。
　これは六波羅の中央軍であり、関東地方に存在する
軍事力として最大のものだ。

　が――それでも、独力ではＧＨＱに拮抗しかねる。
　互角に戦うには地方軍の来援を得なくてはならない。

Shishiku Ootori’s Sasagawa army. The largest regional force, second only to Fudaraku’s central army in size and capability.

Its arrival would bring Rokuhara much closer to parity with GHQ.

One condition, however.

Yes. Some occupation forces were almost certainly moving to contain Koga.

If Koga fell, Sasagawa’s army would lose its road to Kamakura. Fudaraku would be isolated.

At that point... defeat would probably be almost certain.
